content:
Subject: Re: Offer to Take Old Laptops for Free - Ghana Reuse Project

Dear [Trader's Name],

Thank you so much for your generous offer to take our 80 old laptops off our hands. We truly appreciate your interest in reusing these devices rather than discarding them.

After considering the details, we are happy to accept your offer. It's a relief to have a cost-effective and speedy solution for our disposal needs, and we feel great that these laptops will continue their useful life in Ghana.

How would you like us to proceed with the collection and shipping logistics? If you need the laptops dropped off at your premises or if there's a particular pickup arrangement you'd prefer, just let us know and we'll adjust our schedule accordingly.

Again, thank you for stepping in at this time—it truly helps our bottom line and gives us peace of mind about responsible disposal.

Looking forward to coordinating with you soon.

Warm regards,

[Your Name]  
[Your Title]  
[Your Company Name]  
[Your Contact Information]
